title: AML IAM Role Definition
description: Compiled JSON payload for an AML IAM role definition (.iam.md). Validates that the compiled output conforms to the AML v1.2 specification.

spec_version.title: Spec Version
spec_version.description: AML format version. Must equal a platform-approved version string.

iam_id.title: IAM ID
iam_id.description: Stable, immutable identifier for this role. Lowercase kebab-case. Immutable once referenced by any published agent definition.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semantic version of this role definition. Major bump required when removing tool grants (breaking change for referencing agents).

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. draft=not usable in production; active=usable; deprecated=usable but lint warning; disabled=hard compile error on reference.

meta.title: Metadata
meta.description: Descriptive metadata for this IAM role.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name for this role.

description.title: Description
description.description: Two to four sentences describing what this role grants, to whom, and what it explicitly denies.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Security team or individual responsible for maintaining this role.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Searchable labels for discovery and filtering.

last_updated.title: Last Updated
last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last update to this role definition.

cloud.title: Cloud Role Binding
cloud.description: Links this AML role to its actual execution identity in the cloud provider. Optional but recommended; absence produces a lint warning.

role_arn.title: Role ARN
role_arn.description: ARN of the AWS IAM role this AML role maps to.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID (GUID) of the Azure managed identity this AML role maps to.

service_account.title: Service Account
service_account.description: Email address of the GCP service account this AML role maps to.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tool grants. Declares the set of tools this role permits an agent to use. Agents referencing this role may only call tools listed here.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Tool ID. Must resolve to a registered .tool.md file.

knowledge_bases.title: Knowledge Bases
knowledge_bases.description: KB access grants. Declares the set of knowledge bases this role permits an agent to query. Agents referencing this role may only retrieve from KBs listed here.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: KB ID. Must resolve to a registered .kb.md file.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Collection access grants. Declares which memory collections this role permits an agent to access.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Collection ID. Must resolve to a registered .collection.md file.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Compiled from the Markdown body of the .iam.md file. Sections are optional but validated when present.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Compiled from the optional '# Purpose' section. Why this role exists, what persona it represents, and the threat model it enforces.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Compiled from the optional '# Notes' section. Miscellaneous guidance for security reviewers and authors.

aml_id.title: AML ID
aml_id.description: Stable, immutable AML identifier. Lowercase kebab-case or snake_case. Must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{3,64}$.
